facts.text: Capella offers FlexPath, a self-paced learning format charged at a flat tuition rate per 12-week billing session rather than per credit hour, allowing students to set their own deadlines and move as fast as they want.

sources.title: FlexPath from Capella University I Self-Paced Online Learning
sources.quote: Our FlexPath learning format lets you set your own deadlines and use what you know to move at your own pace. Plus, there's one tuition fee per 12-week billing session to help lower costs
